Thanks for the ping, Jonas.

Short answers up front:
- We can accept a signed VAT self-attestation from Helio plus a copy of the PO and invoice reference. That is usually sufficient for us to treat the transaction as B2B reverse-charge, provided the VAT number validates in VIES and the billing/legal entity matches.
- If VIES validation fails, we will need additional evidence (local VAT registration docs or a reissued invoice with VAT).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Ask Helio to return the attached self-attestation (I attached our standard VAT self-attestation template).
2) Provide us with the customer's VAT number and billing entity exactly as on the PO. I'll run the VIES check.
3) Once we have signed attestation + successful VIES check, finance will schedule payment release within 5 business days. If they need an earlier exception, we can escalate to Revenue Ops but need written approval.

Please ask them to include bank transfer details and the PO number on the attestation to avoid delays.

I can take ownership of the VIES check and payment scheduling once we have the doc.
